program='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    marker = min(Counter(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda color: sum(row.count(color) for row in grid))\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r in range(h):\n        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]\n        if len(cols) > 1:\n            for c in range(cols[0] + 1, cols[-1]):\n                if grid[r][c] != marker:\n                    out[r][c] = 3\n    for c in range(w):\n        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]\n        if len(rows) > 1:\n            for r in range(rows[0] + 1, rows[-1]):\n                if grid[r][c] != marker:\n                    out[r][c] = 3\n    return out\n'''
p.write_text(program)
